data.provenance: Seeded synthetic rectangles, not real video frames

evaluation_policy.ap_definition: All-points interpolated AP at IoU .50, mean over classes with GT; not COCO AP .50:.95
evaluation_policy.precision_recall_definition: Micro counts after score filtering and per-class NMS; each same-image same-class GT matches once
evaluation_policy.selection: Last fixed step; no AP acceptance threshold or best-validation checkpoint selection

runtime.scope: Observed wall time for this CPU run, including dataset preparation, training, evaluation and reload; excludes environment installation

limitations: Short overfit exercise on 24 training images for the fixture; no proof of broad generalization.
Independent synthetic sources do not reproduce real camera, lighting, occlusion or motion variation.
Exact duplicate/source checks cannot establish that near-duplicate real frames are independent.
One box per grid cell; same-cell annotations fail explicitly rather than being dropped.
Checkpoint parity verifies this CPU reload, not cross-device bitwise equality or resumed optimization parity.
AP and runtime describe one fixed run only; no YOLO-version ranking or benchmark claim.

image_cli_compatibility.coordinate_note: CLI boxes are in original 80x120 image pixels after undo_letterbox; AP50 evaluation and SVG use 64x64 letterboxed coordinates. Original-image inference is not another test-split AP evaluation.

training_box_diagnosis.contract_diagnosis: All 24 training PNG foreground bounding boxes match JSON pixel coordinates, including empty images. There are 21 objects and 21 positive cells. Letterbox transforms boxes with images; target wh remains nonzero and normalized by 64. Negative cells have zero box gradient. Center errors remain substantial, while some height logits reach -7.062 and sigmoid suppresses recovery gradients. Objectness and classification learning lowers total loss without establishing box localization. These observations support incomplete optimization rather than annotation, scaling or mask corruption; a single predeclared 1600-step follow-up will test whether more fixed steps suffice.

short_run_outcome: Training loss decreases but localization has not overfit: train AP50 .00680, validation AP50 0. No seed, architecture, loss, optimizer or threshold tuning was applied.
followup_decision: After train-only pixel/target/mask/coordinate diagnostics, predeclare one 1600-step run with the same training seed/model/optimizer/train/validation, plus a fresh independently seeded test split (7001); evaluate that new test only once after training. The previously viewed test cannot support the follow-up conclusion.
